text:
maya: Quick design check on the model catalog compare UX. Focus: badges, version pin/lock, and accessibility. Updated frames in Figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-ux-v2

sam: Scanned the frames. Main issue: the perf badges (green) collide visually with the "verified" badge. Recommend separating by color + icon: perf uses a bolt icon, verified uses a star.

elena: Accessibility: the perf numeric text (e.g., 12 ms) fails AA in dark theme. Suggest increasing contrast or using a semi-bold 13px label. Also make the compare rows a real table in table-mode for SR compatibility.

rui: Pinning nit: users want pin at version level. Propose renaming "Pin" -> "Lock to version" and use aria-live announcements: "Locked v2.3 to Marketing workspace". Pin control must be keyboard-focusable inside the row, not only in overflow.

jamal: UX: when a version is locked it should float to the top of compare results and show a persistent banner: "This workspace has locked versions". Also add a link to docs about routing guarantees.

maya: Good. For copy keep it short: button text "Lock version" and announcement: "Locked v2.3 to Marketing". Add undo in toast after lock action.

sam: Filters: make "Compare selected" disabled until >1 selected. Persisting filters per workspace should be opt-in with a small toast "Saved filter preferences" and an undo.

elena: Keyboard help: provide a ? modal listing shortcuts and ensure it's a proper dialog with aria-modal and role. Also add a skip link to jump to compare list.

rui: I'll add the aria snippets and small a11y checklist: aria-live for lock, aria-expanded for filter groups, sr-only skip link, focusable pin target.

maya: Action list: 1) Separate badge types & icons (sam) 2) Rename Pin->Lock + aria-live + toast undo (kevin/jamal) 3) Make pin focusable + keyboard target (rui) 4) Increase badge contrast & table-mode option (elena) 5) Persist filters opt-in + toast (sam/maya) 6) Add ? help modal + skip link (elena/rui)

design-bot: Frame 'compare-ux-v2' updated by maya. Labels: design-review, accessibility, copy.

maya: Thanks all. I'll update Figma and follow up in tomorrow's design crit. Please drop any last comments here before EOD.
